# GNET – Global Network on Extremism and Technology

> > GNET is a research organization studying the intersection of extremism, violent radicalization, and technology platforms, providing evidence-based insights for policymakers and researchers.

GNET conducts rigorous research on how extremist groups exploit online platforms, how youth are radicalized through technology, and how platforms can effectively moderate terrorist and violent extremist content (TVEC). The organization publishes research digests, reports, and hosts events to advance understanding of online extremism and inform policy responses.

## Key Topics

- Extremism research
- Online radicalization
- Violent extremism
- Platform moderation
- Terrorist and Violent Extremist Content (TVEC)
- Online safety
- Nihilistic violence
- Youth radicalization
- Islamic State
- Platform responses
- Extremist financing
- Gender dynamics
- Technology policy
- Content analysis
- Online subcultures

- [GNET – Global Network on Extremism and Technology](https://gnet-research.org): GNET homepage introducing the Global Network on Extremism and Technology research organization
- [What we do – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/what-we-do): Overview of GNET's mission, research focus, and extremism-technology initiatives
- [Who We Are – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/who-we-are): GNET staff, organizational structure, and research institute background information

## Research & Reports

- [Reports – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/resources/reports): GNET research reports on extremism, online violence, platform analysis and TVEC
- [Strategies for Researchers Analysing Terrorist and Violent Extremist Content (TVEC) – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/strategies-for-researchers-analysing-tvec): Researcher guide on TVEC methodology and content analysis strategies for extremism study
- [Beyond Extremism: Platform Responses to Online Subcultures of Nihilistic Violence – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/2026/02/17/beyond-extremism-platform-responses-to-online-subcultures-of-nihilistic-violence): Research report on platform moderation of nihilistic violence online subcultures
- [Understanding Terrorist Innovation: A Case Study in Drone Adoption – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/2026/03/20/understanding-terrorist-innovation-a-case-study-in-drone-adoption): Case study on terrorist drone adoption and technology innovation in extremism

## Research Insights & Digests

- [Insights – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/insights): GNET research insights and extremism studies digest on online safety and platform moderation
- [Addressing Youth Radicalisation and Mobilisation – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/addressing-youth-radicalisation-and-mobilisation): Research digest on youth radicalization, online mobilization, and counter-extremism strategies
- [Gender and Online Violent Extremism – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/gender-and-online-violent-extremism): Research article on gender dynamics in online violent extremism and radicalization
- [Climate Change, Technology, and Extremism – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/climate-change-technology-and-extremism): Research article examining climate change, technology, and online radicalization connections
- [Combating Islamic State Finance – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/combating-islamic-state-finance): Research digest on Islamic State terrorist financing and counter-extremism strategies
- [Extremist Responses to Coronavirus – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/resources/extremist-responses-to-coronavirus): Research digest on extremist responses to coronavirus and platform moderation strategies
- [The Designation of 764 Network: Why Does it Matter? – GNET](https://gnet-research.org/2026/03/16/the-designation-of-764-network-why-does-it-matter): Policy analysis on 764 Network designation and nihilistic violence online subcultures
